  AND (g2.name CONTAINS 'genre' OR g2.aliases CONTAINS 'genre')
RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS painting_name"
,
  "rationale": "I'm matching paintings that have two different Genre relationships - one matching equestrian/portrait characteristics and another matching genre art. Using CONTAINS on both name and aliases properties ensures we catch genre names that might be stored in either field. The DISTINCT ensures we don't return duplicate painting names."
}

}

}
